name: Saturn's Subtitle Tweaks
description: Saturn's Subtitle Tweaks (SST) adds Find subtitles to the Jellyfin Web playback menu: search remote subtitles, download through Jellyfin providers, and apply a temporary timing offset for the current playback only.
overview: In-player subtitle search, download, and session-only timing for Jellyfin Web.

versions.changelog: TV clients: Android TV, Google TV, webOS and Tizen apps never load Jellyfin Web, so SST now drives them from your phone or PC. A banner offers to find subtitles for whatever your TV is playing, and the download is applied to that device. Optional server-side automatic download and an item-page button are off by default.
Crash fix: SST no longer wraps every Jellyfin request. After install, delete the old plugin folder if the server is down, then install 1.3.9 and restart once.
